UK Regional Mayors to Gain Income Tax Powers

UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak announced plans to grant regional mayors powers to collect a share of income tax. The initiative aims to devolve power to local areas, described as giving authority to "every postcode." Supporters claim this will transform regional funding, allowing mayors to borrow for investment and escape reliance on central government "handouts." Critics, however, have raised concerns about the lack of specific details in the proposed plans.
